scripts.build: pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-tokens build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-react build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-workflow build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-gallery build
scripts.check: pnpm validate:style-policy && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
